measurements.relaxation_units: T1 and T2 in seconds; inverse-rate in s^-1; first-order propagated uncertainties
measurements.notes: 900MHz lacks NOE so not used. Each temperature fitted separately.

geometry.nh_vector: Approximate ideal amide N->H from measured CA_i,N_i,C_(i-1) planar geometry, skip prolines/missing peptide
geometry.shape_axis: Largest PCA component from experimental CA positions of chain A; shape surrogate NOT measured diffusion tensor axis
geometry.nh_theta: acos(abs(NH unit dot PCA long axis)); no arbitrary 45 degree NH

variants: PDB NH oriented axial shared ratio fixed CSA
PDB NH oriented axial shared ratio variable CSA
models.fit: Globally select tau and D ratio using training error summed over residues; per-residue S2 and optional CSA fitted on training only

scoring.primary: median 800MHz per-residue sum of squared z_R1,z_R2,z_NOE, same residues for all models
scoring.secondary: per-channel median absolute z, fraction all three within 2 reported SE, covariance caveat and CSA boundary counts
